mapper.select: SELECT property_id AS propertyId, destination_id AS destinationId, safety_score AS safetyScore, cctv_count AS cctvCount, street_lamp_count AS streetLampCount, has_police_station AS hasPoliceStation, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM property_safety WHERE property_id = #{propertyId} AND destination_id = #{destinationId} LIMIT 1
SELECT property_id AS propertyId, address AS address, property_latitude AS latitude, property_longitude AS longitude FROM properties WHERE property_id = #{propertyId} AND del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1

SELECT destination_id AS destinationId, dest_latitude AS latitude, dest_longitude AS longitude, dest_name AS name, dest_address AS address FROM destinations WHERE destination_id = #{destinationId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO destinations ( dest_latitude, dest_longitude, dest_name, dest_address ) VALUES ( #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{name}, #{address} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE destination_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(destination_id), dest_name = VALUES(dest_name), dest_address = VALUES(dest_address)
SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()

INSERT INTO property_safety ( property_id, destination_id, safety_score, cctv_count, street_lamp_count, has_police_station ) VALUES ( #{propertyId}, #{destinationId}, #{safetyScore}, #{cctvCount}, #{streetLampCount}, #{hasPoliceStation} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE property_id = property_id
